description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the PackageManager class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It manages package download, installation, and handling, including initialization, deinitialization, and remote connection management.

classes.name: PackageManager
classes.description: Implements package management functionalities including initialization, deinitialization, and remote connection handling within the WPEFramework plugin system.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the PackageManager with a given service, setting up download, installation, and handler interfaces, and registering for notifications.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, and releases interfaces associated with the PackageManager.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a string with package manager information; currently returns an empty string.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation, potentially triggering cleanup or shutdown procedures.
